jobs.title: Failure Analysis Engineer
jobs.description: Failure Analysis Engineer | Weebit Skip to content Back to Careers Failure Analysis Engineer Job Location Israel, Hod HaSharon (Hybrid) Job Brief Drive fault isolation and root cause analysis of advanced semiconductor devices, with a focus on memory arrays and associated logic and peripheral circuitry. Job Description Lead fault isolation and root cause analysis of memory and logic failures, including electrical, test, and yield failures, from initial failure signature through physical confirmation Analyze failures at device, memory-cell, array, and circuit level, differentiating between design, test, device, process, and physical failure mechanisms Correlate electrical characterization, memory-test and yield results, schematics, layout, and physical FA findings to identify and validate root cause Develop and execute effective fault-isolation strategies, localizing failures down to the relevant cell, circuit, interconnect, or physical structure Work closely with Design, Device, Test/Product, Process, Reliability, and Physical FA labs to solve complex failures and drive corrective actions Improve FA methodologies, prepare and present engineering FA report on complex failure investigations Required Skills and Experience Sc. or M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Engineering, or a related technical field 5+ years of relevant experience in semiconductor failure analysis, fault isolation, silicon debug, memory characterization, product engineering, or a related field Strong experience in fault isolation and root cause analysis of semiconductor devices Ability to analyze electrical, test, and yield failure signatures and correlate them with schematics, layout, circuit behavior, and physical findings Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to drive complex investigations across multiple engineering disciplines Nice to have: Understanding memory architecture and digital/analog circuitry Experience with non-volatile memory or advanced memory technologies such as Flash, MRAM, PCM, ReRAM, or similar technologies Experience with memory tests, ATE, electrical characterization, yield analysis, and memory fault analysis Familiarity with advanced fault-isolation and physical FA techniques, such as EMMI, OBIRCH, LIVA/TIVA, laser-based techniques, nanoprobing, SEM, FIB, or TEM Apply now We use cookies to enhance your experience on our website. jobs.title: Analog Design Engineer
jobs.description: Analog Design Engineer | Weebit Skip to content Back to Careers Analog Design Engineer Job Location Israel, Hod HaSharon (Hybrid) Job Brief Be part of the team that is responsible for developing and optimizing the state-of-the-art analog circuits that power our embedded ReRAM and mixed-signal products. Job Description In this role, you will take the lead on designing high-performance analog circuits, driving innovation in mixed-signal systems from concept through production. You’ll partner closely with digital design, system architecture, and process engineering teams, playing a key role in bringing our next generation of memory products to market: Design and develop complex analog circuits, including amplifiers, complex memory arrays, and LDOs, ensuring reliability and performance Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define system specifications and architecture, translating requirements into actionable designs Conduct thorough simulations and analyses to validate designs, using tools such as Cadence Virtuoso and Siemens Solido while identifying and mitigating risks early in the design process Oversee the transition of designs from prototype to production, ensuring compliance with quality and industry standards Apply deep expertise in analog circuit design – including amplifiers, voltage references, comparators, and ADCs/DACs – to push the boundaries of performance Required Skills and Experience Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field 6+ years of experience in analog circuit design, with a proven track record of successful product launches Strong knowledge of analog design principles and methodologies, including feedback systems and signal integrity Proficiency in industry-standard design and simulation tools Experience with CMOS technology, 90nm-16nm Familiarity with mixed-signal design and signal processing concepts Strong communication skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts to diverse audiences Proven ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment while also excelling in independent projects A proactive and innovative mindset, eager to push the boundaries of technology Nice to have: Ability to model circuits using VerilogA or SystemVerilog Familiarity with sign-off simulations (IR/EM) Hands-on experience with layout tools Understanding of manufacturing processes and testing methodologies related to analog circuits Apply jobs.description: Experienced Analog Design Engineer | Weebit Skip to content Back to Careers Experienced Analog Design Engineer Job Location France, Grenoble Job Brief An Analog Design Engineer with at least 5 years of experience to play a key role in the design and development of our advanced memory technology. Job Description You will be involved in all aspects of the analog design process, from concept to validation, and will be responsible for the design of analog circuits: Propose analog architecture to ensure high-quality functionality and enhance performance Take initiative in exploring new design approaches and solutions Design and simulate analog and mixed-signal circuits, such as Sense amplifiers, Bandgaps, LDOs, for embedded non-volatile memory applications Commit to delivering high-quality design compliant with the specifications Work closely with the technology and layout teams to ensure robust and efficient implementation of designs Utilize and master industry-standard design tools and methodologies Generate clear and concise reports on design progress and results Collaborate effectively within an international team environment Contribute to the definition of product specifications and testing strategies Mentor junior designers Required Skills and Experience Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience in analog integrated circuit design Solid understanding of fundamental analog design principles, including amplifiers, oscillators, voltage references, and data converters Proficiency in using industry-standard EDA tools for simulation and layout (e.g., Cadence, Synopsys) Proficiency in mismatch and corner validation of analog circuits Experience with memory circuits or non-volatile memory technologies is a plus Demonstrated ability to work independently and take initiative Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills Strong communication skills with the ability to produce clear and concise reports Ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment and work effectively within a team Apply now We use cookies to enhance your experience on our website.
